description.short: Ask your Twenty CRM questions and update records from Teams.
description.full:
Ask Twenty about your CRM from Microsoft Teams: look up people, companies and opportunities, create and update records, and capture notes and tasks. Message the bot in a personal chat, or mention it in a channel or group chat.

This app needs a Twenty workspace with the Teams application installed, chat enabled and a workspace Microsoft connection. The bot answers as the workspace member whose email matches your Microsoft account. Answers are generated by AI.

commands.title: help
commands.description: See what you can ask Twenty
